title: Console backend: integrate Standard Cost Model (SCM) API client for cost breakdown pages
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Problem
- Console is adding a cost breakdown experience that depends on the Standard Cost Model API. We need a robust Console backend client with caching + sane fallbacks so SCM slowness/outages do not degrade core Console pages.

Scope
1) Add SCM client in Console backend
- Implement a typed client to call cost-model-service endpoints:
  - POST /v{N}/cost-model/estimate (for summary + breakdown)
  - POST /v{N}/cost-model/explain (for tooltips / “why is this cost high?” drilldown)
- Support version negotiation per ADR-0147.
- Include tenant + route + model identifiers and request context (region, sku, quant_profile_id, batching/caching signals when present).

2) Wire to Console endpoints
- Add/extend Console backend endpoints backing the Cost Breakdown UI to fetch SCM outputs.
- Ensure consistent response shape for the UI even when SCM is unavailable (empty/error states).

3) Caching strategy
- Add caching to reduce load and protect SCM p95.
- Cache key should include:
  - tenant_id
  - time window (rounded bucket)
  - route_id (or api_key scope if route not available)
  - model_id + resolved model_version (if pinned)
  - scm_requested_version + negotiated_version
  - scenario knobs that affect cost (batching enabled, kv_cache enabled, quant_profile_id)
- TTL:
  - Default 30s for “current” window
  - 5m for historical windows (>= 1h ago)
- Prefer in-process LRU cache for hot path + optional shared cache (Redis) behind a flag if needed for multi-instance hit rate.

4) Fallback behavior / guardrails
- Hard timeouts and retries:
  - Client timeout 350ms (budgeted for page rendering)
  - 1 retry only on connect/reset/5xx with jittered backoff (max additional 150ms)
  - No retry on 4xx validation errors
- If SCM errors/timeouts:
  - Do not fail the Console request (return 200 with SCM section marked unavailable)
  - Provide a stable error code for UI copy selection (e.g., SCM_UNAVAILABLE, SCM_TIMEOUT, SCM_INVALID_INPUT, SCM_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION)
  - Log + metric increment with tenant tier and endpoint label
- If SCM returns low confidence:
  - Surface the confidence value to UI and allow UI to render “low confidence” badge.

5) Observability
- Emit metrics from Console backend:
  - scm_client_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99)
  - scm_client_error_rate by error_class
  - scm_cache_hit_ratio (in-process vs shared)
  - scm_fallback_rate (rate of UI seeing unavailable)
- Add structured logs with request_id, tenant_id (hashed), scm_version, and error_class.

Non-goals
- No billing logic changes.
- No client-side (browser) calls to SCM; all via Console backend.

Acceptance criteria
- Console backend can fetch SCM estimate + explain payloads in staging.
- Console pages remain functional when cost-model-service is down/slow (validated via fault injection).
- Caching reduces SCM QPS for high-traffic tenants (target: >= 60% hit ratio for 30s bucketed current window).
- Version negotiation works: Console requests v1; if v2 is configured later, older Console builds do not break.
- Metrics and dashboards exist for latency, errors, and fallback rate.

Links
- Confluence PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/standard-cost-model-api-prd.json
- SCM Spec v1: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/standard-cost-model-spec-v1.json
- ADR-0147 Versioning: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-0147-cost-model-versioning-and-negotiation.json
- SLO targets: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/cost-model-api-slos.json

Implementation notes
- Use the existing Console service client framework (same as model-catalog client) to standardize auth headers + tracing.
- Ensure we do not leak customer-sensitive fields into logs; redact payload fields beyond IDs + high-level dimensions.
- Canonicalize request payload before hashing for cache key (stable ordering; avoid floating point instability).
- Prefer server-side rounding for time windows to prevent cache fragmentation.

Open questions
- Do we need per-route breakdown export now? (PM says no; track separately.)
- Confirm which UI views require explain vs estimate only (Marissa to confirm).

comments: 2025-02-10 (Chloe Martin): Starting with estimate endpoint only; will add explain once UI tooltips are finalized. Need clarity on which dimensions are mandatory vs optional to avoid high 4xx rate on missing region/model_version.

2025-02-12 (Jordan Lee): Please make sure Console sets both required/acceptable version headers (per ADR) so we can roll out v2 without breaking old Console deployments. Also: avoid defaulting missing region silently; better to send explicit 'unknown' and let SCM confidence drop.
2025-02-18 (Sean Gallagher): Timeout budget looks OK but add a circuit breaker so repeated timeouts don’t cascade. Also ensure Console endpoint returns within existing SLO even when SCM is unhealthy.
2025-02-21 (Dylan Brooks): UI needs a stable “unavailable_reason” field for copy. Please align with Design’s empty state; avoid showing $0 or misleading values.
2025-02-26 (Chloe Martin): Added in-process LRU cache (30s/5m TTL). Holding off on Redis until we see hit ratio in staging. Added fallback path returning 'scmStatus: unavailable' and no cost numbers.

2025-03-03 (Talia Benson): Confirmed staging fault injection: SCM forced 1s latency => Console endpoint still returns within 650ms and UI shows 'Estimated cost unavailable' state. Good for launch gating.
definition_of_done: Client integrated and gated behind feature flag; caching enabled; fallback behavior verified under SCM outage/latency injection; version negotiation covered by tests; metrics emitted and visible on dashboard; rollout plan documented for staged tenant enablement.
